10000.text: Ha. I'm looking forward to working with you.
Hahaha! You wanna see what I can do, right?
Y-You don't recall making such a promise? Ahaha! I guess we never did agree on that, did we?
Welcome, Sensei! I'll be your bodyguard again today!

10001.text: Isn't it kind of hot in here?
I often hear that I lack emotion, but I don't really understand what that means.
It won't affect my graduation, will it...?
I've been waiting for you, Sensei.

10002.text: Taiyaki? It's my favorite food. Heehee.
Do I enjoy going to gourmet restaurants? Heehee. I suppose I don't mind them.
Pretty...? Wh-What are you talking about?
Oh, that was a compliment. You should take it. Heehee...

10003.text:
This? This is Peroro.
Isn't he cute?
What do I worry about? Being too average, I guess...
Is there anything you need my help with?
Ahaha... Nothing's going to come out no matter how hard you shake it...

10004.text: As long as I'm here, I'm like every other club member.
What do you mean it's okay if we're seen?! Wh-What has gotten into you?!
No cutting corners! Do your job properly!
I will aid you to the best of my ability. Call on me if need be.

10005.text: This place is cool. I like it.
I imagine you have it rough, Sensei.
Huh? You actually mean it? Oh, o-okay... Th-Thanks.
There's no shame in pacing yourself. It's important to take your time.

10006.text: I'm free for a while, so I can help you out a little bit.
Why are there so many troublemakers in the world?

Well, I don't mean that you need to follow the rules all the time.
But remember, I'll hold you accountable when you don't follow them.

There's no such thing as a rule that makes sense to everyone.
That's why the rules have to be enforced.

10007.text:
Is there something on my face?
...Huh? Paint?
Isn't this design cool? I did it myself!

What would be the point?
Every hacker needs to leave behind a calling card. Heh heh...

I have a cool idea.
Sanctum Tower is at the heart of Kivotos, so what if we tagged it with graffiti?

10008.text: God. Did you really make me wait? Unbelievable.
All right! Wanna get this cleanup duty thing going or not?
Now you know what it's like to work with the best, right?
I always get the job done.

10009.text: Are there any missions where we punish naughty restaurants by eating all their food?

I wonder if there are any good places near Schale.
I did raid a restaurant near Trinity...
Oh! Should I not have said that...?

Huh? Are you giving me this cracker?
Thanks, Sensei! You're so sweet!
(That octopus pancake from before looked pretty good...)

10010.text: (Why is Sensei staring at me like that?)
Being together like this isn't so bad.
If there's something you need done, you can always let me know.

10011.text:
Come on, Sensei! You can't act like a child when you're with me.
If it's only every once in a while... I'll let it slide.

If you keep doing that...
...I'm gonna yell at you!

Welcome back, Sensei. What would you like to do first? Eat or take a bath?
Or...would you rather have class first?

10012.text: Let's start off with a nice run.

Huh? Why don't I wear my school uniform?
Training in it is uncomfortable.

Weight training is all the rage among the students these days.
...Yeah, I know. I wish that were the truth.
Think of you calves like another heart. You have to train them.

10013.text:
T-Today is another great daaaay!
Wait! No, that's not it! What was I supposed to say?!

I d-don't know much about grown-up stuff!
So I'll do whatever you tell me to do!

10014.text:
What will today's mission be, my lord? Scouting the enemy camp? Rear infiltration?!
Huh? Studying for tomorrow's test?

Are you going out on a patrol today, my lord?
I'll stick by you as though I were your shadow! Nin nin!

I may be a ninja, but I can also play the role of the femme fatale!
Especially with you, my lord!

What? I'm not supposed to use my skills on you?
Then...I'll have no one else to use it on...

10015.text: A new game is coming out soon! You will play it with me, correct?

Mmm. I am hungry. Huh...?
No! I do not eat batteries!

It has been many a millennium since humans last set foot here...
I have always wanted to say that.

I do not know why, but I can shed tears.
They must be to wash my ocular lenses.

10016.text:
I'm worried about the Game Development Department.
I know I'll be okay as long as I'm with you...
You played our game too, right? Which part was your favorite?

I want to draw even more beautiful things... But I need to practice.
Can you help me?
I don't want my art to just be about moe, I want it to convey "love" too.

10017.text: You're with me today. It's time to partake in revolution, Comrade!

Can't you feel my authority?
Worry not, Comrade. You have nothing to fear. I am quite merciful.

Huh? My mustache fell off?
Huh...? Nooooo! My authority...
What the heck? It's right where it's supposed to be! Is this a joke to you?!

10018.text:
Yes, you can ask me anything.
I'll... I'll do my best!

Oh... I really want a pet cat.
Games and cats... That's all I need to be happy in life.

Yes, Sensei. I'm going to become stronger.
Just like how you and everyone else protected me... I want to help everyone too.

10019.text:
If life has no intrinsic meaning, then why do we live at all?
Huh? Oh, it's nothing.

Missions. Objectives. Achievements.
I've never really thought about much else...
...until now, anyway.

I wonder if I'm being helpful...
I am?
I-I see...
It's okay. I know I'm no fun. Sorry to disappoint you.

10020.text: I-I won't forgive anyone being naughty where I can see!
Quiet about my grades...! I'm trying my best.
I'm gonna do my best to quickly graduate from the Make-Up Work Club.

N-Naughty things...?
No such thing allowed! I'm gonna confiscate everything and burn it into ashes!

10021.text:
Wh-Why are you staring at me?
I knew it. Is my outfit too flashy?

Hmm? What am I doing?
Nothing in particular, really.
And that's how I like it.

I get to experience a lot of new things when I'm with you.
I never could have imagined this in the past.

These clothes offer no particular defense to my midsection.
Hmm? You think it makes it more powerful? What is that supposed to mean?

10022.text: This swimsuit? I thought it'd be perfect for my summer training.

No, I didn't hold particularly high hopes for this summer.
...Maybe a tiny bit.

Resting is just as important as training?
I suppose, but I can't just neglect training.

You want me to ask for help when I need it?
Thank you, Sensei. Just hearing that makes me happy.

10023.text: No eating while walking! No exceptions just because it's a resort.
What's that smile on your face? Surely you're not excited about the ocean, right?
What? You can't stop smiling after seeing my swimsuit?
Heehee. Lemonade tastes so much better at the beach.

10024.text:
I've been working on improving my cadence when cycling.
I heard pedaling faster while at a lower gear makes for good practice.

I haven't had as much time to cycle lately due to task force work.
That's why I'd like to go the distance today.

There's lots of parts I want to buy, but I need to hold off.
Bicycle parts are expensive.

Actually, I made several of these jerseys hoping to go cycling as a group.
But the others refused, so it's just me.

10025.text: I'll be a good kid and wait patiently!

Sensei, Sensei! Someone gifted us Roy's rum raisin chocolate!
Can I try one right now?

I can't have a snack because it'll spoil my appetite?
But they look so good...

10026.text: Why are you looking at me like that? Is it that weird?

Huh? My bomber jacket?
Give it up. Wherever I go, it goes.

Things are pretty slow today. How about you give me something to do instead?
I'm not really a fan of standing around and doing nothing.

Do you need anything?
If there is...maybe I can help you.

10027.text: My outfit? Is there something strange about it?

Who I am doesn't change just because of an outfit.
I'm still me.

Sensei? Do you have something to say?
Huh? You want to touch my ears?

When I wore the maid uniform, I worked with a sense of dutiful service, but...
...I don't know how to feel in this outfit.

10028.text: Hmm? What's wrong? I thought you liked it. Do you want to try it on for yourself?

It's natural for bunnies to seek attention.
That's why you have to pet them, Master!

Hmm. I'm kinda bored.
But you know, I'm happy as long as you're here, Master!

10029.text: What's wrong, Sensei? Is your tummy hungry? Should I get you something to eat?
I'm curious, Sensei. What do you usually like to munch on?
I don't only talk about snacks!
Sensei. Don't you know there's always room for dessert?

10030.text:
During breaks, I try to forget about work.
But the more I do that, the more my mind wanders.

I don't know why, but since I'm wearing something like this here, I'm...
I'm a bit nervous.
Sometimes you need a break... You say it so much that I've always wanted to say it back to you.
A hot spring... I never thought I'd find myself in such a place.

10031.text: Sensei, you've made an excellent choice continuing your contract with us this year. ♪
Are you asking if it's hard to tie my hair back this high?

Not really. To be honest, my wallet's the one having a hard time...
Huh? I-It's nothing...!
This kimono is pretty, don't you think? Isn't it beautiful?

10032.text:
Sensei, what should we play today?
Rock, paper, scissors? Kick the can? Or...
Hide. And. Seek?

Oh, right. You're an adult, Sensei. You can just play all day, yeah?
I've got an idea...
I can help!
Maybe it's because I'm wearing this, but I feel like I have more energy than usual!
Come on, Sensei, you can do this! Let's finish work quickly and have lots of fun!

10033.text:
What would you like?
I'm ready to do anything, no matter what.
Now, just give me the word, and I'll see that it's done.
Everything is yours. My heart, my soul, everything.

Just tell me if there's something, anything you want.
Yes, anything and everything. ♥

10034.text:
Did you wash your face this morning? You didn't skip breakfast, did you?
Heehee. Yes. Good Job. Then how about a nice cup of black tea?

If there is anything you need, whatever it may be...
Yes, you can ask me anything.

You're always so busy, Sensei.
The time I spend alone with you like this is precious.
O-Oh. I-I just let that slip out, didn't I?

I've dreamed of becoming a proper bride ever since I was young.
Like the ones I read about in mangas and novels.

10035.text: This place is somehow different. Maybe it's your presence.

I-Is there anything I can do to help?
I-If there's something I can do, please let me know!

10036.text: I-I just wonder...if I'm helpful to you in any way.

Even though I'm supposed to be a manager...
...I'm always making mistakes... Is that really okay?
J-Just tell me what to do! I'll do my best no matter what!

I heard there are a lot of rumors going around about me. I wonder what they're about.
No one in the Sisterhood will tell me...

10037.text: We, the fearless Red Winter bears, will begin the hunt!
I'll report you to the Secretariat for sabotage if you slack off!
Wh-What are you touching? I'll send you to the Spec Ops!

Who's Medvezi?
Medvezi is a loyal teddy bear that sleeps on my bed.
There's no guarantee of good sleep without him.

10038.text: RABBIT Squad is ready to mobilize at any time.

I suddenly got curious...
What kind of sound does a rabbit make?
If you encounter an enemy you can't handle alone, make sure to call us.

The RABBIT Squad emblem...
Isn't it cute?

10039.text: Um, Sensei... D-Do you remember me?
It's always h-hard for me to make new f-friends...
I wish the RABBIT Squad members got along b-better...
I w-wish I was stronger...like th-the others...

10040.text: Did you...call me by any chance?
N-No. I'm not trying to run away...
Um, am I in your way? Can you see behind me...?
If you can't, I can crouch a little...

10041.text: What's going on? I can help you...if you want.
I'll do what you ask. Just say the word.
If there's anything you want, tell me.

I'm not very good at making small talk.
If that's your order, I'll follow it.

10042.text: Please inform me if I can assist you.
Can I decorate this with flowers too?
Tell me anything you need or want.
So this is what being on the roster means. I've always wanted to try this.

10043.text:
You can tell me anything.
Yes, "anything." ♥

During summer, everyone lets their guard down and gets excited...
So, it's not an exaggeration to say that anything can happen!
Heehee...

Can I move just a little closer to you? ...Huh? That close?
O-Oh...?!

I've been wanting to take a walk with you, but...
It's too hot today, so it'd be best to wait until the sun goes down.

10044.text: Summer is hot...but it's also full of exciting things!
Don't you feel excited just hearing the word "beach" for some reason?

...Hmm? Sensei! What is it?
Is there something wrong with my swimsuit...?
By the way, Sensei. Do you know how to swim?

10045.text: Are you really gonna make me work while I'm wearing something like this? Heh~

You're busy as usual, Sensei.
...Can I help you with this?

...Huh? Do I want to rest? I mean, yeah, but...
It's awkward to just watch you work.

Let me know anytime you're tired, Sensei.
Instead of a pillow, how about this tube?

10046.text:
You're working so hard, even on such a hot day, my lord...!
Though I'm unworthy, I'll support you!

So, my lord, can you help me learn CPR?
...Oh, are you not available right now?

When we have a chance next time, I'd love to play at the beach with the president, Tsukuyo, and you, my lord!

This summer, I'll protect you as I always do, my lord! Nin nin!

...What do you think?

10048.text:
Is this helping?
...Okay. That's all I needed.

I can't seem to figure it out.
Your orders, Sensei. That's my purpose.

10049.text:
Let me know anytime you have something going on.
Oh, but I'm not good at reading complex sentences...so I'll pass on that.
It's comfortable here... It makes me kinda sleepy.
Sensei. Let's eat something, okay? Should we go out and get something?
...Huh? Don't mind me. I'm watching you work.

10050.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to working with you today.
I know how to teach a class. Do you wanna take my class?

What's going on?
You called me just because? What the...
Ack! D-Don't poke me! Hmph! I'm not a little kid.

10051.text:
Whether you're healthy or sick, energy is the best medicine.
Especially if you need to kick-start your creativity.
Feeling down? I see that frown. Your mood'll rebound, just hear my cheer resound! ...I'll try again later.

As long as you're here, Sensei...
I feel like I can do anything.

I'm glad I get to see this side of you, Sensei.
What do you think? Do you like it?

10052.text: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just...observing.

Anything interesting on your mind?
Please let me know so I can record it immediately.

Everyone read it,
but no one gave me their feedback.
Strange, isn't it?
Yuuka is so expressive. It's never boring when she's around.

10053.text:
As a treasurer, and as an athlete...
...all I can do is my best.

This outfit...is a refreshing look?
Wh-Where did that come from?!
Well, um... Thank you...

You like my ponytail?
Y-You're always just...saying things like that!
...Doesn't mean I don't appreciate hearing it, though...

Come now! There's a mountain of work that needs doing!

10054.text:

If it's okay with you, could I stay with you a while?

Do you want to talk?

Have you thought about what to get the children this year?

Santa is an important tradition, for the children's sake.

Perhaps I could be more helpful to you.

Let me know anytime.
I'm always ready...

Osechi are typically all boiled foods.
However, it seems these days that's not always the case.

The ideal situation is one in which the Remedial Knights aren't needed at all.
I hope we'll continue to see such peaceful days.
Welcome, Sensei. Let's work together towards peace in Kivotos, as always.

I mean, I didn't really know what to expect, but...
Well... I'm not really bored or anything!
If you need help, I'm at your service! You can count on me to do my very best.
Oh... I see. That's how you look when you're working.

10060.text:
Hmm... What should I do here?
Do you need to be warmed up? Or...

What do I do in my free time? Uh... I dunno...
Oh! You were looking for work!

That's why I like to get rid of things and start all over!

Are you hungry? Do you want me to make you some ramen?
Huh? Tools?
I'll use this! ♪

10061.text:
I'm supposed to assist you at Schale...
It's different from my usual work, so I'm a bit nervous.

Work at the cathedral?
It's okay. I've been organizing my schedule.
Yes, Sensei. If there's anything I might be able to do...
Anything regarding the cathedral, or any other work...please let me know.

10062.text:
Report for duty? At your command.
...Please give me a reward when I'm done.

Do I need a break?
I've been taking enough breaks, thanks to you.

I have a little bunny rabbit impression I can do.
Boing.
...Please hurry and compliment me.

10063.text:
Can I help you with anything?
Or should I just help you by not doing anything?

Calculations?
They're easy! Not that I like doing them, though.

Did you call me to find a password, by any chance?
I'm not your notepad!

Oh, did you tell my upperclassmen that I'm here?
If I don't let them know, they'll scold me later...

10064.text:
You think I'm...even cuter in a kimono?
Hmph. Don't say stuff you don't mean.

Hah. That's more than enough teasing out of you, Sensei.
Wait, you...you mean it? E-Even so, that's enough!

About Problem Solver... Don't worry. It's nothing big.
I hope there aren't any...incidents...this year.
What's wrong, Sensei? I can help you with whatever.

10065.text:
...Oh? You say I've always been a help to you?
Heehee. Thank you. That is a relief.

When things are tough, I draw strength from my collection of Chise merchandise.
...Shall I give you a piece, Sensei?

Schale is certainly admirable.
To think that you'd be able to host advantageous exchanges with so many students...

10066.text:
When I wear a maid uniform, I feel as if my cleaning skill level has increased!
Sensei, do you need me to clean somewhere?

I have heard that a maid has many duties!
Cooking, cleaning, laundry, destruction, ambushes, security and even world peace! ♪

I have heard that a calm mind is very important for a sniper.
Um, S-Sensei? When you pat my head like that...

Sensei, what is on your task list for the day?
Oh, you are going to spend all day vegging out? And you want me to join you?

10067.text:
I am a rabbit, and not a puppy...
But if you make me to wait like this...
I might make a mess.

What was it you called me for?
Is there an operation? Is it security? Combat? Destruction? Justice?
Huh? There wasn't a reason you called?

Schale duty is certainly interesting.
You seem busy, and yet you're not working...

It's not that I'm always eager for work.
I, too, enjoy killing time.
However... I'd like to be someone you can rely on, Sensei.

10068.text: You called me, Sensei? What did you wanna talk about?

Ah, was my voice...too loud?
Your head was ringing? Oh no! Sorry!

Hmm. Interesting!
I've noticed that when I come here, some of my tension just goes away!

Um, do you have an errand for me to run, maybe?
It feels a bit weird to just stand here...

10069.text:
This is Schale... Ah, sorry.
I rarely spent so much time away from the kitchen. It's not what I expected.

To a chef, the kitchen is a battlefield...
Does that mean this is Sensei's battlefield?

Sure you have something I can use to cook here...
I was thinking about making something.

Food is important, isn't it, Sensei?
Don't skip meals, and don't eat just anything. Got it?

10070.text:
No person can live alone...
It's a cliché, but I don't hate it.

Humans should be wary of other humans... But humans must also trust their fellow humans.
Should I trust you, Sensei? Or...
Don't worry so much, Sensei. Everything will be okay by tomorrow.

I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
What does the world have in store for us today? I'm excited.

10071.text:
I've only ever worn SRT Academy's standard-issue swimsuits before, so...
...this cute design feels a bit unnatural to me.
I'm pretty good at swimming, although Saki can still beat me...
Since I'm off-duty right now... I can help you with non-mission related things.

Maybe that means cows are good swimmers, since cow print suits are pretty popular.
A rabbit pattern would be really nice though...

10072.text:
We need to be careful about dehydration. Drinking water is very important.
It's also important to get enough sodium.

I really don't like the ocean much.
Firearms malfunction more easily in that environment.
I'm using a waterproof tactical map, meant to be used at sea.
(It would have been nice to come to the sea with everyone for a reason other than a mission...)

10073.text: Indoors is better. I feel so much calmer indoors...

When it's just the two of us, it's so quiet and peaceful...
Oh, never mind. Forget I said anything.

I can help you organize files,
but I'm not so good with computers...
Maybe next time...we can try working in the old library?

10074.text:
I think I've become more mischievous than I used to be.
Especially when it comes to you, Sensei.
If there's anything I can do for you, just let me know.
Aah, if you touch me there... Heehee. ♡
Heehee, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to give you a hard time, Sensei.

10075.text: I know it's a bit off task, but...I've got a lot to do...

Art and knowledge both come from freedom.
So starting now...I'm going to start freely drawing you!

This is your battlefield, Sensei...!
I feel it... I can feel it. The energy! The chaos!

The greatest fan book authors start with a blank page...
In other words, I also have what it takes to become a great fan book author!

10076.text:
Oh, this outfit?
What do you think? Isn't it pretty?

Uh, umm... I'm not sure why, but...
I feel little embarrassed...
D-Don't just look at me like that. Please say something!
Schale needs cheerleaders too, so this cheer is just for you!

10077.text:
My, working here is quite comfortable!
Ah. I'm not saying that it's easy, of course. It's just very pleasant.

My most difficult work... I'd say it's breaking up fights.
Oh, you too, Sensei? We're the same.
I wish that everyone would simply relax and not get so worked up...
If I'm given a great responsibility, like Sensei has been... Will I be able to immerse myself in it completely?

10078.text:
It's not like I'm just digging wherever I want, you know?
I have a little more sense than that.

Hm? There's more to developing a hot spring than digging around in the dirt?
I like building things too, of course!

We just never get to that stage, is all!
Wahaha! It's just one of the things I love about my job!

When I'm with you, Sensei, I'm just as happy as when I'm digging up hot springs.
Hahaha! Don't be so guarded!

10079.text: Going outside by myself is still a tall order...

You want me to help out during power outages...? You're kidding, right?
...I guess I could help if you really need me to.
Sometimes I think this place is just like my Academy City.
Sensei, do you want to get some fresh air?

Your work looks terribly difficult... Can I help you in some way? Within reason, of course.
To be perfectly honest, my head still hurts a bit.
My remote control? It's important, but... It's not special in and of itself.

10081.text: Hm, hmm. I see. This is a typical work day at Schale. I'm learning so much!
It's all going to work out perfectly! Yes! Because I'm an elite member of the Hyakkaryouran!
Yes, Sensei! Please don't hesitate to ask me for anything you need!

Heehee. Welcome, Sensei! Time to work!
Here, this way! Please sit down!

10082.text:
It seems we have similar struggles, Sensei.
Work is just an endless chore wheel, isn't it?

I oversee all training for Hyakkaryouran members. There's not enough hours in the day sometimes!

Our relationship is that of youth teacher and student! Mentor!
It's time to enjoy my youth! And in that spirit...

I'm always indebted to you, Sensei... No, Mentor.
Please tell me everything and anything, Mentor!
I'll do whatever is within my power.

...You're thanking me? For...helping with Schale's work?
Hah. You are misguided if you believe my motives are to assist you, Sensei.

Conducting Schale duty is disappointingly simple.

I recommend you dress for the weather when you go out this weekend.
